title: Periphrastic verb forms
subtitle: Recognize εἰμί plus participle as one verbal expression.
overview: A form of εἰμί with a participle can function as a periphrastic verbal expression. Read the pair together before assigning a separate clause to each word.
The construction may give prominence to a state or ongoing situation, but context—not a slogan—determines the best English.

sections.title: Read as one expression
rows: you have been saved / are saved

items.grc: καὶ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ.
items.en: And he was teaching them in the synagogue.

items.grc: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως.
items.en: For by grace you have been saved through faith.
